notes: The guide's Sources note and its evidence were checked on 23 September 2026 against jfs-components 0.1.60; the docs now install 0.1.78, so everything resting on them is stale until re-checked. The Configuration, States, Sizing and Content examples carry titles only (no captions), so the states have no described behaviour beyond their names and the one description sentence. The guide gives no accessibility guidance, although its Sources note records duplicate checkbox roles and Space not toggling the row (both recorded as gaps). The evidence says mobile-fit visual QA of the expanded sections is still pending. The package marks label as deprecated in favour of children; the guide's Sources note still speaks of "a string label". The package docs describe a Figma default composition (Text plus Link in the label slot, "I agree" + "Terms & Conditions") that the guide does not cover. The guide names no other component to use instead, so avoidWhen is empty. Re-extracted 29 October 2026 (Penny run run_19b90d38) for the dbe0e02 publish (#357, #409): the nested-checkbox and Space gaps are fixed and removed; the new Sources sentence on keyboard and screen-reader behaviour is the accessibility item.

evidenceFacts.name: endSlot
evidenceFacts.description: A press on the end-slot Button does not change the selection; a press on the row toggles it.
evidenceFacts.quote: clicking the Details Button updated only its documentation status; the row stayed unselected.

evidenceFacts.name: children
evidenceFacts.description: Preferred over the legacy label; the row forwards its modes to slot children.
evidenceFacts.quote: prefers `children` over legacy `label`, and forwards owner modes to slot children.

evidenceFacts.name: control
evidenceFacts.description: With control trailing, the end action comes first and the Checkbox last.
evidenceFacts.quote: With Trailing control, the end action appears first and Checkbox last.

evidenceFacts.name: label
evidenceFacts.description: A string label wraps; the Long label story's name does not mean it truncates.
evidenceFacts.quote: A string label wraps in the checked implementation; the story name does not establish ellipsis behavior.

evidenceFacts.name: endSlotWidth
evidenceFacts.description: Figma's end slot is 80 px, matching the default; the nested Checkbox is 18 px.
evidenceFacts.quote: the nested Checkbox is 18px and the end slot is 80px

evidenceFacts.name: Button / Size
evidenceFacts.description: Not in CheckboxItem's mode list; set in the row's modes, it reaches the end-slot Button, and XS fits the 80 px slot.
evidenceFacts.quote: The public action uses Button Size XS through the owner modes to fit the documented 80px slot.
